title: The miracles of Allah’s messengers
intro: Allah supported His messengers with miracles – signs no person could do.

learn.html: A mu‘jizah (miracle) is an extraordinary event that Allah (SWT) gave to a messenger as proof that he truly was sent by Allah. No person could do it by their own power – it happened only by Allah’s will.

learn.title: Why miracles?
learn.html: People asked the messengers for proof. With the miracles Allah showed that the messengers spoke the truth, so that people would believe and follow them. Each miracle fitted what that messenger’s people knew best.

learn.text: Miracles of some of the messengers

items.label: Ibrahim (AS) – the fire became cool and safe for him
Salih (AS) – the she-camel that came out of a rock
Musa (AS) – his staff became a snake, and the sea split in two
Sulayman (AS) – he understood the speech of birds and ants
‘Isa (AS) – he spoke as a baby and healed the sick by Allah’s permission
Yunus (AS) – he came out alive from the belly of a great fish

items: The Qur’an – his greatest miracle, and the only one that lasts until the end of the world. Nobody can bring anything like it.
Isra and Mi‘raj – the night journey to Jerusalem and the ascent through the heavens.
The splitting of the moon – the people of Makkah saw the moon split in two. (Qur’an, Al-Qamar 54:1)
Water flowing from between his fingers, so that many companions could drink and make wudu.

learn.title: Mu‘jizah and karamah
learn.html: A miracle given to a messenger is a mu‘jizah. An extraordinary gift Allah gives to a very pious believer who is not a prophet is called a karamah.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Miracles happen only by Allah’s will. The miracles of the earlier messengers were seen by the people of their time – the Qur’an is a miracle we can still read, hear and learn today.
